recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片中淋巴濾泡不明顯，副皮質區（paracortex）大幅擴張，並可見許多明顯的高內皮小靜脈與血管分支穿行其中，淋巴結結構大致保留，符合 ALPS 的副皮質增生型態。
features: Lymph node with intact thin capsule at the right edge
Marked expansion of the paracortex/interfollicular zones by densely packed lymphoid cells
Prominent branching vessels (likely high endothelial venules) running through the expanded paracortex
Few discernible secondary follicles at this magnification
Overall nodal architecture preserved without sheets of large atypical cells
describe_en: Low-power lymph node section (H&E) shows a preserved capsule with marked expansion of the paracortex and interfollicular areas by a dense lymphoid population traversed by prominent branching vessels, consistent with high endothelial venules. Secondary follicles are inconspicuous at this magnification, and no sheets of overtly atypical large cells are identified, although cytologic detail cannot be evaluated at this power. The pattern of florid paracortical hyperplasia is consistent with autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome in the appropriate clinical and flow cytometric context (increased CD3+ TCRαβ+ CD4- CD8- double-negative T cells).

ddx.vs: PTCL shows effacement by atypical T cells with loss of pan-T antigens and a clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas ALPS double-negative T cells are polyclonal and cytologically bland.
Viral hyperplasia contains many immunoblasts with EBER positivity and lacks expanded double-negative T cells.
RDD is sinus-based with large S100-positive histiocytes and emperipolesis, which may coexist with ALPS but are not evident here.
Identified by CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin-Reed-Sternberg cells at higher power.
